findings.finding: Set BC=Fₙ₊₂, BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ sides: a=Fₙ₊₂, b=s−Fₙ, c=s−Fₙ₊₁ (s>Fₙ₊₂). Compute geometry: A from sides, incircle I=(Fₙ,r), r=area/s. Find F,E as perpendicular feet from I to AB,AC. K = reflection of A across line O‑O₁ (circumcenters of ABC and AFE). K′ reflect K across EF. N=proj_D onto EF. Enforce K,N,K′,B cyclic ⇒ solve for s (unique). Ratio R=CT·NB/(BT·NE) at that s. Numerically R→2+√5≈4.23607 as n→∞ (even n). Thus α=2+√5 ⇒ p=2,q=5. Compute 2^{5²}=2^{25}=33 554 432; 33 554 432 mod 99991 = 57447.
